title: OES-Resilience: Benchmarking telemetry intelligence under real-world stress
description:
Open, reproducible benchmark for multichannel telemetry anomaly detection. Synthetic 512-channel signals are split into sixteen 32-channel blocks and scored by block-level detectors behind a plugin API: the transparent OES32 reference detector (0.45·max|x| + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·mean|x|), a robust z-score baseline, EWMA and CUSUM temporal detectors, and an optional Isolation Forest.

Version 0.2.0 adds multi-step synthetic streams and a scorecard in which every detector's threshold is calibrated the same way on held-out clean data, reporting false-positive rate, recall, exact localization, IoU, detection latency and machine-dependent CPU time.

Synthetic data only. Not quantum, not GPS or navigation, not a physical sensor, and no performance claims about real systems.
